Referencer.title: List a practitioner
Referencer.text: Are you a practitioner or a figure of African spirituality? Submit your file: it will be reviewed by the HWENDOXI committee before any publication. No profile is published automatically.

Form.title: List a practitioner
Form.intro: This five-step form lets you submit your file. It will be reviewed by the HWENDOXI committee before any publication. You choose which information you authorise us to publish.
Form.emailHelp: Never published. Used to follow up on your file.
Form.idNotice: Your identity document is used only for verification. It is never published, can only be viewed by authorised verifiers and is deleted after the committee’s decision.
Form.fileHelp: Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF (2.5 MB maximum for a PDF). Images are reduced automatically.
Form.publishIntro: Information you authorise us to publish:
Form.pubNote: Your email and documents are never published. Without authorisation, information stays private.
Form.accTerms: I accept the terms of use.
Form.accAccuracy: I confirm that the information provided is accurate.
Form.accPhotoRights: I confirm that I hold the necessary rights to the photo provided (if you attach one).
Form.sendNotice: Once sent, your request receives the status “Awaiting validation” and a tracking code.
Form.errFile: A file is too large, in an unsupported format or unreadable. Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image, or a PDF of 2.5 MB maximum.
Form.errPhotoRights: Tick the confirmation of rights on the photo, or remove the photo.
Form.errInvalid: Some information is invalid or missing. Please check the form.
Form.errTooMany: Too many requests in a short time. Please try again later.
Form.errTooLarge: The files are too large. Please use lighter files.
Form.errGeneric: Sending failed. Please try again later.
Form.doneText: Your listing request has been received. Our team will review your information before anything is published on HWENDOXI.
Form.codeNote: Keep this code: it lets you check the status of your file. Current status: Awaiting validation.

Tracking.title: Track my request
Tracking.intro: Enter the tracking code you received when you submitted your file to see its status.
Tracking.notFound: Code not found. Please check what you entered.
Tracking.error: Unable to check right now. Please try again.
